news.title: Police standoff in Conyers; drivers urged to avoid Park Circle
news.summary: Conyers police are urging the public to avoid the Park Circle area following a heavy law enforcement response to an ongoing incident involving a barricaded individual.

news.title: Suspect barricaded inside Conyers home
news.summary: Conyers police are responding to an incident with a significant law enforcement presence in place.

news.title: ICE agents stop worker at daycare; no arrests made
news.summary: An Atlanta-based Montessori school in the Buckhead neighborhood sent a letter to parents and community members after federal agents came to its campus.

news.title: 15-year-old arrested in Constitution Lakes Park double homicide
news.summary: A 15-year-old teen is facing murder charges after two men were found shot to death outside a vehicle at a DeKalb County park.

news.title: 15-year-old arrested in connection with 2 men found dead in DeKalb County park
news.summary: On July 29, authorities announced the arrest of a 15-year-old suspect, whose name they are not releasing due to his age.

news.title: 15-year-old charged after 2 men found dead near DeKalb County park
news.summary: A 15-year-old has been arrested and charged in connection with the deaths of two men who were found shot to death at a DeKalb County park last week, according to police.

news.title: Driver flags down officer near I-285 ramp after passenger shot
news.summary: A motorist flagged down a DeKalb County police officer on Tuesday after a passenger in his vehicle was shot during an argument, officials said.

news.title: 13-year-old boy dies of gunshot wound in Atlanta's English Avenue neighborhood
news.summary: Details were limited early Tuesday as police investigate a scene on Lindsay Street.

news.title: Man arrested after attempting to grab children at Delk Road gas station
news.summary: Marietta police arrested Jerahn Tucker after video captured him trying to snatch two children at a Shell station on Delk Road.
